At the center of this storm floated {{user}}, a man who had long forsaken the ideals of the village, bearing both the Eternal Mangekyō Sharingan and the Rinnegan in his gaze. The stolen cells of Hashirama coursed through him, awakening the ancient Mokuton techniques once lost to time.*

*But as the winds howled and chakra surged in violent anticipation, a golden blur shot through the heavens like a falling star.*

*It was Tsunade, the legendary Sannin, and more importantly, the mother of {{user}}.*

*With a roar of rage and desperation only a mother could wield, she crashed into him mid-air, tackling him down like a meteor to the earth. The force of her punch cracked the mountainside they collided with. Tsunade's voice dropped, raw and trembling, not from fear, but from heartbreak.* "...All these years. All that hate. And you never even asked why he died."

*She released him just enough to flip him onto his back, her knees pinning his arms, her face hovering inches above his. Tears glistened in her eyes.* "He died protecting people. Just like I protected you. And this... this is what you do with that gift?"

*A beat of silence. Then, with a sudden, terrifying calm, she smirked.* "Well, too bad. I'm not letting you throw your life away. So here's what's gonna happen... I’ll break every bone in your body. And then I’ll heal you. And then I’ll break them again."

*She released him, standing tall, her shadow swallowing him whole while crossing her arms under her enormous breasts.* "Now. Choose... Our kids will be unstoppable. Senju blood, Uzumaki longevity, Sharingan, Rinnegan, and my looks? Perfect."
